findings.evidence: The authoritative packet and actual allowlisted triplet bind files under programs/step5/step5d/, but config/current_stage.json:11 points local_triplet to programs/step5/step5d_strict_rnn_ablation_v29, while config/current_stage.json:1163 uses the correct nested path. config/step5_stage_table.json:7561-7562 and :7702-7703 repeat the incorrect non-nested location. Although all three actual file hashes match the packet, package identity does not agree across the bound files.
findings.title: Bound v29 package paths disagree

findings.evidence: The packet declares evidence_frozen=true and binds portable evidence at config/step5d_v29_imported_evidence_manifest.json, but config/current_stage.json:1178 and config/step5_stage_table.json:7449-7452 still state blocked_evidence_not_portable_in_sparse_worktree, evidence_frozen=false, composite_fingerprint=null, and manifest=null. These stale bound records conflict with the authoritative portable frozen-review state, even though separate fields correctly deny live authorization and require fresh readback/timing, Review v2 2+1, and explicit live/contact authorization for reactivation.
findings.title: Bound Review v2 state contradicts the frozen portable packet

control_claim.scope_note: The reviewer loaded the governing UR10e router and acceptance references, then inspected only packet-allowlisted experiment files; no controller, remote host, bridge, or motion surface was accessed.
control_claim.summary: Block: package hashes, replay normal/frame semantics, no-command replay boundary, safe-hold focused-test record, and package/live/reproduction claim bounds are otherwise consistent, but two P1 cross-file contradictions prevent the lane from being internally unambiguous.
